audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Yone/Skill/Yone against the content layer's Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Karma/Yone/Karma — six of seven rows disagreed. Worse, the content layer disagreed with itself at Level 6: win[4] said Karma while whys[4] and the mid paragraph both said Fate Sealed tips that phase to Yone.
audit.why: Mortal Steel reaches 450 against Inner Flame's 950 and needs two stacks before it dashes, so levels 1-3 are Karma's. Fate Sealed at 120s makes 6 his. Crit items make first item his. Late, Karma's shields and roots out-value single-target burst.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 to Karma, row 3 Skill, rows 4-5 to Yone, row 6 to Karma, in both layers. win[4] moved Karma -> Yone to agree with its own why and with the full layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] named the first-item spike as 'usually Immortal Shieldbow or a Kraken-style spike' — placeholder phrasing with no source; spikes[1] attached 'Lethal Tempo/Conqueror ramp-up potential from R-empowered dashes' to level 6, which the kit does not support.
audit.why: What actually changes at 6 is Fate Sealed: 120s at rank 1, 1000 range, blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls everyone hit toward him. What changes at his first item is the Q3 dash burst plus Spirit Cleave shielding every 14 seconds.
audit.corrected: Both spikes rewritten on kit facts; the item name and the rune speculation dropped rather than replaced with a guess.
sources: enemyKit W cd 14 and shield text

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] described 'knockup-adjacent E stun chains' and the early/mid paragraphs referred to 'W tether stuns' — Karma's E is a shield with no CC at all, and her W roots rather than stuns. The mid/late text also had Mantra healing the frontline. packet.defects flagged that no Yone ability was ever named; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Riot's text: Focused Resolve tethers and roots; Inspiration shields and grants move speed; Mantra-W heals KARMA, not allies — the ally-side effect is Mantra-E. Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s against a flat 12s tether, which is the real cadence of this lane.
audit.corrected: Fabricated E stun and W stun removed; Mantra heal corrected to Mantra-E shielding; breakdown.cooldowns now carries Soul Unbound 22s/10s, Mortal Steel 4s, Spirit Cleave 14s and Fate Sealed 120s; every ability named.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood pasted under 'RE-speed the disengage window' and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad under 'Trade extended past your root' (lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: The disengage bullet should be about Mantra-E against the Fate Sealed pull; the extended-trade bullet should be about Mortal Steel coming back every 4 seconds.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours outright: Karma's Q-E poke combo out-damages Yone's safe Q1/Q2 wave-clear pattern, and your range means he can't contest CS without eating free damage every trade. He has no reliable gap-closer until his Q3 mark stacks up (usually 3 autos or spell hits), so if you poke and back off you deny him easy lane presence. By level 4 it's a coinflip skill matchup — whoever lands more W tether stuns versus more accurate Q3 dash-ins decides the exchanges, since both champions are now threatening real damage.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours outright: Karma's Q poke out-damages Yone's safe Q1/Q2 wave-clear pattern, and 950 range against his 450 means he can't contest CS without eating free damage every trade. He has no reliable gap-closer until Mortal Steel reaches its second stack and dashes, so if you poke and back off you deny him easy lane presence. By level 4 it's a coinflip skill matchup — whoever lands more W tether roots versus more accurate Q3 dash-ins decides the exchanges, since both champions are now threatening real damage.

edits.before: Level 6 flips hard onto Yone: his ultimate becomes a legitimate all-in and pick threat that punishes any Karma who's used Mantra offensively rather than defensively, and his crit-scaling damage output starts outpacing your poke DPS. You still have Mantra-empowered E to zone him during the actual wave-clear phase, but the moment he's ahead on gold or gets jungler priority, he can dive through your shield and burst you before your W stun lands. Play this phase around vision and never let him get a free Q3 engage — bait his dash onto minions, not onto you.

You still have Mantra-empowered E to zone him during the actual wave-clear phase, but the moment he's ahead on gold or gets jungler priority, he can dive through your shield and burst you before your W root lands. Play this phase around vision and never let him get a free Q3 engage — bait his dash onto minions, not onto you.

edits.before: Late game is about your Mantra utility keeping teammates alive through his engage, since a fed Yone's R can delete your positioning mistakes in half a second and his double-crit passive shreds through E shields fast. Peel hard with W tether and Mantra-heal your frontline rather than trying to trade damage with him directly — Karma wins these fights through sustain and CC uptime, not raw burst. If you can keep him from ever getting an isolated pick on you, his damage is wasted and your team's sustain grinds the fight out.
